summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for integrating both Model Context Protocol (MCP) and REST & AI APIs into the Root Planner Topology Studio:
- Full-Stack Express Server (server.ts) with Vite middlewares running on port 3000
- Multi-transport MCP server support (local stdio for Claude Desktop / Cursor and HTTP SSE transport for remote clients)
- In-App interactive MCP tool explorer & execution console
- Core REST API endpoints for topology validation, project management, and bundle export
- Server-side Gemini AI integration (gemini-3.8-flash) with an interactive "AI Architect" generator modal on the canvas
